notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only (curl with browser-impersonation UA). Canonical host is schoolhouse.com (www. 301-redirects to it, no anthropic/Claude-bot disallow in robots.txt, standard Shopify robots). No client-rendering block encountered, so no escalation to Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome was needed. TREE: pulled the Shopify sitemap index (sitemap_collections_1.xml, ~300 collection URLs) and the homepage's rendered mega-menu (Dawn theme header__inline-menu block, all HeaderMenu-* nodes present in raw HTML - no JS execution needed). The live mega-menu has 9 top items: Bestsellers, Lighting, Bed+Bath (>Bedding>Duvet Covers/Quilts+Coverlets/Sheet Sets/Pillowcases+Shams; >Bath>Bathroom Hardware/Lighting/Mirrors; standalone Throw Pillows), Hardware, Decor (incl. duplicate Throws+Pillows standalone), Furniture (incl. Storage Furniture), Rugs (standalone leaf), Organization (standalone leaf), Ready to Ship. The sitemap union additionally surfaced dozens of orphaned collections (shower-curtains, bath-textiles, bath-mats, linens, table-linens, blankets-throws, bed-linens, bins-baskets, baskets, waste-bins, hooks-racks, carts-and-racks, shelves-ledges, storage-organization, office-utility, living-room-storage, dressers-storage, domestic-utility, stockings) that are not linked from the current live nav or any collection's own sub-nav (collection pages only re-render the same global header links, no per-category sub-strip exists on this theme). QTY: read id=ProductCountDesktop on each collection page and cross-verified every figure against unique product handles from /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (exact match on every candidate checked). EXCLUDED (checked, not textile/storage): all Lighting/Hardware/Furniture/Decor/Mirrors nav branches (out of scope categories); Bathroom Hardware, Bathroom Lighting, Bathroom Mirrors (Bath sub-nav, non-textile fixtures/hardware); Storage Furniture (/collections/storage-furniture, 8 products - explicitly nested under the Furniture mega-menu, storage.md Sec21 'if the website explicitly places the product inside a Furniture category, prefer Furniture'; belongs to the already-validated Furniture.xlsx, not touched); bed-linens (23 products, orphaned page whose contents are a superset re-aggregation of the same items already captured individually under Duvet Covers/Quilts+Coverlets/Sheet Sets/Pillowcases+Shams - dropped as redundant re-aggregation, not a distinct site category); Throws+Pillows (/collections/throw-blankets-pillows, Decor mega-menu standalone) - verified identical 8-product set to Throw Pillows (/collections/throw-pillows, Bed+Bath standalone), kept only the latter per duplicate-record rule; Bath Textiles (/collections/bath-textiles) - verified identical 2-product set to Shower Curtains, kept only the latter (bath-textiles is the redundant parent-style label, no other children); Organization (/collections/organization, live nav leaf, 15 products) - inspected full product list: 8 are wall hooks (Hardware/Wall Decor, not in storage.md vocabulary), 3 are Miller Storage Cart color variants (genuine Storage, but only reachable via the separate orphaned /collections/carts-and-racks URL), 1 Torrey Wall Shelf (Wall Decor per storage.md Sec18 boundary), 1 Schoolhouse Utility Stool (Furniture), 1 Stacking Trays + 1 Yves Catch-All (Decorative Home Accessories per storage.md Sec24); since >70% of the collection is non-storage, the whole-category qty=15 was not recorded as Storage - only the narrower Carts+Racks URL was used instead; hooks-racks (8, all wall hooks - Hardware, not Storage), shelves-ledges (1, Torrey Wall Shelf - Wall Decor), storage-organization (3: utility stool/tray/catch-all, same non-storage mix as above), office-utility (9: rugs+stool+lamps+hooks+tray - thematic merchandising page, not a real category), living-room-storage (3: cabinet+stool+wall shelf - thematic merchandising page), dressers-storage (0 products, name mixes Furniture 'Dressers' with 'Storage', ambiguous and empty so not verifiable, excluded), domestic-utility (0 products, name too generic to map to any storage.md vocabulary term), stockings (0 products, seasonal/gift item per textile.md Sec15, excluded) - all excluded as either non-storage content, thematic pages, or unverifiable-and-ambiguous empties. Zero-product orphaned pages with clean, unambiguous rule-vocabulary names (Bath Mats, Table Linens, Kitchen Linens, Throw Blankets for Textile; Bins+Baskets, Baskets, Waste Bins for Storage) were still recorded at qty=0 per the zero-product-category allowance (storage.md Sec39, applied analogously to textile) since the sitemap is an explicit tree-building source per the brief and the 0-count was independently corroborated via products.json - each flagged MANUAL REVIEW for its orphaned/unlinked status. Company is confirmed primarily a lighting+hardware+furniture brand as expected; genuine Textile presence is real but modest (Bedding, Throw Pillows, Shower Curtains, Rugs); genuine Storage presence is essentially a single ambiguous Carts+Racks line plus empty legacy placeholders.
